ios.desc:
Eureka Surveys members have earned over $42 million to date, and a staggering 80% of new members earn $5 sent to their PayPal within the first day of downloading.

Sign up for free, and we'll start you off with $1 for your first survey. Turn your opinions into earnings immediately and receive your rewards via PayPal, Amazon Gift Cards, or choose from over 70+ gift cards.  Every survey you complete pays you cash. Also, don't miss out on free daily money just by taking part in our daily pay poll.

We are the top rated money making app for a reason. Earn money with Eureka in THREE ways:

1. Surveys: get paid cash for sharing your honest opinion with researchers
2. Check Ins: instantly claim free money from your favorite brands with a single tap
3. Daily Poll: vote on today’s question to claim your free money

Join the 4 million happy Eureka members and start making money today! With over 300,000 reviews, we are the most trusted money making app. If you earn with Swagbucks, Poll Pay, Attapoll, Survey Junkie, Surveys on the Go, Qmee, Zap, Fetch Rewards, Earnin, Ibotta, Mistplay, or Foap, give us a try!

Please reach out to support@eurekasurveys.com for questions/inquiries. We pride ourselves on our quick response times - most inquiries are addressed and resolved within just one business day because we value your time. Happy earning!

Looking to take surveys on desktop? Find us at eurekasurveys.com
